test_group_invalid_link: ❌ That doesn't look like a link. Send a link starting with https://
create_method_prompt: Choose how to create a quiz:
pdf_instructions:
Send your PDF file.

I will analyze its content and automatically generate a quiz.
pdf_invalid: ❌ This file could not be read as a PDF.
pdf_too_large: ❌ PDF size exceeds the allowed limit ({limit} MB).
status_failed: ⚠️ A temporary error occurred while generating the quiz. Please try again.
ai_error_generic: ⚠️ A temporary error occurred while generating the quiz.
edit_menu_title: ⚙️ Editing "{title}". What would you like to change?
edit_reorder_prompt: Reorder the questions with the ⬆️/⬇️ buttons. The list top-to-bottom is the order the questions appear in the quiz.
edit_prompt_description: Send the new description (send /skip to clear it):
edit_prompt_time_limit: Choose the new time limit for questions:
edit_question_added: ✅ Question added. There are now {count} question(s).
edit_delete_question_last_one: ❌ A quiz must keep at least one question.
manual_choose_subject_intro: Let's create a new test. First, choose the subject.
manual_choose_subject: 📚 Which subject is this test for?
manual_choose_grade: 🏫 Which grade is this test for?
manual_enter_title: Let's create a new test. First, send me the title of your test (e.g. "Knowledge check" or "10 questions about biology").
manual_enter_title_for_subject:
Great! Let's build a {subject} test ({grade}th grade). Now send me the title of your test.

For example: "{example}"
manual_title_example_history: The era of Amir Temur quiz
manual_title_too_short: ❌ The title must be at least 3 characters long. Please send it again.
manual_enter_description: Great. Now send me a description of your test (a link is fine too). This is optional, you can skip this step: /skip.
manual_poll_instructions:
Great. Now send me your first question as a poll. Alternatively, you can send a message with text or media to be shown before this question.

Note: this bot can't create anonymous polls. Users in groups will be able to see how others voted.
manual_question_added:
Good. Your test "{title}" currently has {count} question(s). If you made a mistake on a question, you can undo it by sending /undo.

Now send the next question, or a message with text/media to show before it.

When you're done, just send /done to finish creating the test.
manual_ask_image: 🖼 Would you like to attach an image to this question? Send a photo, or /skip to skip it.
manual_ask_link: 🔗 Would you like to add a source/link to this question? Send a link, or /skip to skip it.
manual_image_rejected: 🚫 This image was detected as inappropriate (18+/graphic) content and was not accepted. Please send a different image or press /skip.
manual_invalid_poll: ❌ This looks like a regular poll. Please enable "Quiz mode" when creating the poll and mark the correct answer.
manual_waiting_for_poll: Please send the question as a poll (📎 > Poll, "Quiz mode").
manual_need_at_least_one_question: ❌ You need at least 1 question to finish the test.
manual_undo_removed: 🗑 Last question removed. There are now {count} question(s).
manual_undo_nothing: There are no questions yet, nothing to undo.
manual_choose_time_limit:
Set a time limit for questions. In groups, the bot will send the next question as soon as time is up.

If your questions involve complex problems (e.g. math), we recommend allowing more time. For most simple tests, 10-30 seconds is enough.
quiz_submitted_title: 📨 Test created and sent for admin review.
quiz_submitted_for_review: 📨 Test sent for admin review. You'll be notified once it's approved.
schedule_group_only: ❌ Scheduling a quiz only works inside a group.
schedule_prompt_datetime:
🗓 Send the date and time the quiz should start.

Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (e.g. 2026-09-20 18:00)
Time is Tashkent time.

Send /cancel to cancel.
schedule_invalid_format: ❌ Invalid format. Please send it as: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (e.g. 2026-09-20 18:00)
schedule_must_be_future: ❌ The time must be in the future (at least 2 minutes from now).
schedule_too_far: ❌ A quiz can only be scheduled up to {days} days ahead.
schedule_confirmed_group: ✅ "{title}" will start automatically at {datetime} (Tashkent time). When the time comes, the bot will post a message with a "✅ Ready" button.
schedule_gave_up: ❌ The scheduled quiz "{title}" didn't start: the group stayed busy with another quiz for too long. Please schedule it again.
